_meta.description: Corsair subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: bleed, lifesteal, dirty fighting.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats de 1% et la chance d'appliquer des effets de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage by 1% and effect chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente le vol de vie de 0.8% et l'ATK de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases lifesteal by 0.8% and ATK by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des debuffs infliges de 0.8% et la reduction de degats de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 0.8% and damage reduction by 0.5% per level.
